title: The candidate bundle learns it is stale: in-modal writes re-pull it, SWR
deviations_from_card: (1) invalidatesBundle('drafted') is TRUE, not false: automation-run.ts:741 records rejection_drafted / interview_prep_generated via recordAutomationEvent (a pipeline event the history shows), so the card's acceptance line was factually wrong for that outcome. The map is 'quiet' {advisory,no_alternative,already_rematched,already_sent} + 'stage-moved' {advanced,auto_ratified} -> false, everything else (incl. undeclared outcomes, outreach sent/suppressed, offer_sent, skipped_stage_changed) -> true, failing toward fresh. (2) Write set SHRANK: CandidateFooterTray.tsx, PipelineSelfSchedulingPanel.tsx, useCandidateTask.ts untouched - link mints invalidate from useCandidateState keyed on useTokenLink's `data` (non-null only on a successful mint), which is a truer 'minted' signal than the voice panel's onCreated (fires on failure too). (3) Write set GREW by one line in CandidateActivityTab.tsx (onResent={st.onLetterResent}) - the coordinator's slot-B hand-off asked for exactly this to close the resend loop; the resend goes through invalidatesBundle({kind:'resend'}). (4) No catalog keys: the consent Retry uses the existing common.retry (all 4 locales), so messages/*.json untouched. (5) 10 acceptance cases instead of 8 (added reset-on-candidate-switch and resend).
notes: Critic revision honoured: drawerCommsTruth.test.ts consent guard now pins dispatch({type:'fail',seq}) + bundleFailed: consentFailed(state), forbids the old setHistory([]) / setBundleFailed(true) wipe, pins onRetry={st.retry} in the Record tab, ConsentPanel still has exactly ONE fetch( (Retry uses a reloadTick standalone, the bundle's retry in the modal); slot B's 'one recovery door' block untouched. Perf measured on git-archive(HEAD)+my files only: app/page.tsx 1424->1425 modules, 9065->9073 KB (ceilings 1428/9098), zero findings - no ceiling raised. The live-tree test:perf overages (page.tsx 1440/9166, job-ingest, hire-from-need) come from siblings' uncommitted files. Full test:unit rc=1 on 3 FOREIGN failures only: python-runner-concurrency (sibling's in-flight app/_lib/python-runner.ts), task-failure-code (FLAKE), drawerCommsTruth 'simulation and refused channel literals live in ONE module' (sibling's in-flight app/_lib/comms-dispatch.ts re-declares SIM literal); all my tests pass. tsc errors only on foreign paths (voice ReconnectNotice/VoiceInterview, JobsRediscoveryFeed, untracked kpi-sim/). Known residual: a re-pull in flight while a note save completes could re-hydrate the pre-save note (useCandidateNote hydrates whenever not dirty) - same pre-existing window the stage-move re-pull had, now reachable after task/link/resend; not closed here. Revoke links is deliberately NOT an invalidation: the bundle reads no revoked-session state (grep 'revok' in candidate-timeline.ts is empty). loop_open: none.
